info.title: Payroll Earmarked Funds Document (A2X)
info.description:
This service enables you to create, read, update, and delete the earmarked fund master data from SAPS/4HANA Cloud system.

This service is based on the OData V4 protocol and can be consumed in SAP Fiori apps and other user interfaces.

x-sap-shortText: Create, read, update, and delete payroll earmarked fund master data synchronously using this inbound service

values.text: Manage Payroll Earmarked Funds Document Integration (SAP_COM_0958)
You can use this API in custom communication scenarios. For more information, see Custom Communication Scenario app.
[Earmarked Funds for Position Budget Control (6X0)](https://me.sap.com/processnavigator/SolP/6X0 " Link To BP ")
